epistemic_answers.meaning: The campaign did not measure the question.
Relevant evidence exists, but it cannot support a conclusion.
The question was measured and relevant observations conflict.
The preregistered yes criterion was met within the declared boundary.
The preregistered no criterion was met within the declared boundary.
The question cannot be answered as written.
None of the registered choices accurately describes the result.

rules: Every prior question receives exactly one epistemic answer and one lifecycle disposition.
Yes and no answers require resolvable artifact identities and an applicability boundary.
Not tested, insufficient evidence, and invalid are complete valid answers.
Rephrasing or splitting creates new question identities and never rewrites the old question.
Retiring a question is not the same as answering it.
An explanation may describe missing evidence but may not invent an observation.
